defects.source_says: Section 1-105 makes DoD gasohol use subject to section 815 of the DoD Authorization Act, 1980 (10 U.S.C. 2388 note). The held 10 U.S.C. 2922c text, which the rationale itself names as a search hit, shows section 815 was restated as 10 U.S.C. 2398 by Pub. L. 97-295 (Oct. 12, 1982), and that its DoD motor vehicles provision (former subsec. (a)) was struck out by Pub. L. 104-106, sec. 1061(h), Feb. 10, 1996. The claim never addresses this statutory repeal of the provision the clause incorporates, so no current predicate for 1-105 is shown.

reasoning: Identity (46 FR 2023, Jan. 5, 1981, gasohol), the quoted spans and the eleven-clause inventory check out, and sections 1-101 to 1-104 and 1-106 to 1-110 are adequately supported. The order status yes is not in doubt.

defects.source_says: Section 8 is a one-time supersession, and the claim admits it took effect. The order fixes its dates (Schedule 8 on January 1, 2026; the other schedules on the first pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2026). The held OPM notice (91 FR 4973) says "The pay rates in E.O. 14132 have been superseded" and dates that pay period January 11, 2026. A performed supersession is spent; this batch records every "is hereby revoked" clause as terminated on performance. Under the 2026-10-28 owner ruling, an event known to fall within an interval must be recorded as such (or blocked), not carried as operative because the date is inexact.
